articleTitle: The Advantages And Pitfalls Of Closed Captioning For Advanced Television
Pilot Tone Selection For Channel Estimation In A Mobile Ofdm System *
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of selecting pilot tones for channel estimation in mobile OFDM systems. It is shown that the best set of tones are those which are equally spaced. Furthermore, for a first order Markov channel, it is more efficient to distribute the pilot tones in the successive symbols.

articleTitle: A Novel Memory Compression System For Mpeg-2 Decoders
abstract: A low-complexity memory compression scheme is described for MPEG-2 video decoders. It can be implemented with minimal hardware and can be utilized to bring decoder memory requirements down to 50% with no distinguishable loss of image quality.

articleTitle: A Minimum Drift 3-layer Scalable Dtv Decoder
abstract: This paper describes new techniques for implementing a low-cost video decoder that can decode an HDTV bitstream and display the signal at lower resolutions. A new architecture is introduced through the derivation of a minimum drift motion compensation scheme.

articleTitle: A Novel Adaptive Vector Quantization Method For Memory Reduction In Mpeg-2 Hdtv Decoders
abstract: A method to reduce the memory needed in an MPEG-2 HDTV decoder architecture is presented and discussed. The total amount of memory is reduced from 86 to 32 Mbits preserving a good picture quality. Furthermore this approach maintains a low hardware complexity and increases of less than 5% the total decoder silicon area in 0.35 μm technology.

articleTitle: Gigabit Video Interface: A Fully Serialized Data Transmission System For Digital Moving Pictures
abstract: A I -bit serial 1.56Gb/s data transceiver chip set for base band transmission of XGA moving pictures was developed. It integrates PLLs, ENC/ DEC, cable driver/equalizer and synchronization controllers required for transmission without any expensive external devices.

articleTitle: Experiences In The Design Of Dab Front-ends
abstract: This paper discusses the impact of conventional RF parameters of DAB front-ends (i.e. 3rd order 2-tone intermodulation ratio, noise figure, phase noise, frequency and phase response, adjacent channel and image frequency selection) on the bit error rate (BER) that is obtainable from DAB receivers. The results of theoretical study are compared with experimental results.

articleTitle: A Simple Algorithm For The Reduction Of Blocking Artifacts In Images And Its Implementation
abstract: In this paper we present the concept and the hardware realization of an algorithm for the removal of blocking artifacts in images and image sequences coded at very low bit rate. The algorithm is based on a Rational Operator which outperforms other conventional techniques and presents a very simple structure too.

articleTitle: A Fast Three Step Search Algorithm With Minimum Checking Points
abstract: The three step search (TSS) has been used for real time video processing and low bit-rate video communications because of reduced computations, simplicity, and reasonable performance in the motion estimation. Other modified algorithms of TSS have been studied for speed of computation and the performance of motion vector estimation. This paper proposes a new algorithm (Fast Three Step Search) for more efficient reduction of computational complexity. It is shown that the proposed algorithm (FTSS) is very efficient in computation while keeping the reasonable performance.

articleTitle: A Single-chip Hdtv Video Decoder Design
abstract: Development has been completed for a single-chip MPEG2 Main Profile @ High-Level Video Decoder that decodes and displays all 18 ATSC digital video formats, including HDTV. Additionally, it can “downconvert” HDTV inputs to SDTV resolution and incorporates programmable filters for display output reformatting. By using RambusTM DRAM technology, adequate memory performance was achieved for a single-chip implementation. Applications include digital TV receivers, set-top boxes and computers.

articleTitle: A Flexible Mpeg2 Decoder Lsi With A Special Transport Stream Risc Processor
abstract: An MPEGZ decoder LSI which has a specially designed RISC processor for transport stream decoding is described. It realizes a good flexibility for all services from different broadcasters in the world without sacrificing the host processor ability .

articleTitle: Motion Estimation For High Performance Transcoding
abstract: In this paper, we show that in some applications, this re-use scheme introduces significant quality degradation due to non-optimized motion vectors. We propose a motion vector refinement scheme which uses the motion vector extracted from the incoming video stream as the base motion vector, and then performs a motion estimation in a very small search range around the base motion vector. We also discuss the situation when the transcoding process involves frame-skipping.

articleTitle: Real-time 2-3 Pull-down Elimination Applying Motion Estimation/compensation In A Programmable Device
abstract: This paper presents a software package that performs real-time picture processing on a commercially available programmable device’. The package applies motion estimation and compensation techniques for judder-free display of movie material broadcast in 2-3 pull-down mode.

articleTitle: Internet Personal Live Video Streaming Station Using A Scaleable Video Distribution Technique
abstract: Software Vision is a technology that makes real-time video distribution possible, either over the Internet or over an intranet. Software Vision is currently implemented on the Real-time Stream Transport Protocol (RSTP). RSTP can change data stream rate dynamically, depending on the situations of server, network and clients.

articleTitle: One-chip baseband decoder for a dab receiver
abstract: This paper describes an one-chip baseband decoder for a Eureka147 DAB (Digital Audio Broadcasting) receiver. This LSI developed 0.35um CMOS technology. It contains 2M/DRAM for deinterleaver, and consumes 750mW at 3.3V power supply voltage.

articleTitle: A 113db Snr Oversampling Sigma-delta Dac For Cd/dvd Application
abstract: A sigma-delta (Σ Δ ) audio digital-to-analog converter WAC) for CD and digital versatile disk (DVD) application is presented. The converter uses a 6-bit modulator and a segmented noise-shaped scrambling technique to achieve a 113dB dynamic-range over a 20Khz bandwidth.

articleTitle: Texture Feature Extraction Using Teager Filters And Singular Value Decomposition
abstract: The use of singular value decomposition (SVD) values and quadratic Teager filters for image characterization is investigated. SVD values and Teager filter outputs represent different characteristics of the image texture and this property is utilized to efficiently characterize the image. Local energy values of the image texture are found by using 2-D energy filters. Filter outputs are combined with the eigenvalues obtained from SVD of local image portions and they form the feature vector for the given image.

articleTitle: Mp@hl Mpeg2 Video Decoder Ic For Consumer Atsc Receivers
abstract: Basic architecture and many unique features of a new single chip MPEGZ video decoder and format converter IC are described. This IC can provide output resolutions as high as 1920x1080 pixels for high definition TV receiver applications, or provide output resolutions of 720x480 pixels for set-top box applications.

articleTitle: A Global Car-radio Ic With Inaudible Frequency Jumps
abstract: A single-chip car radio IC has been realized which is suitable for global applications 1). Different regional requirements can be met by software setting of the receiver parameters. The internal tuning control algorithm feature and the adaptive PLL frequency synthesizer allow inaudible frequency hopping for quality checks on other signals.

articleTitle: A Single-chip Dtv Media Processor
abstract: This paper describes a single-chip media processor' for use in Digital Television (OW) applications and covers its features, system interfaces and application areas.

articleTitle: A Novel Phase Noise Suppression Technique In Ofdm Receiver
abstract: This paper proposes a novel phase noise suppression technique which is very effective for tuner phase noise reduction and Doppler effect canceling in mobile reception by OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) receivers. A remarkable bit error rate improvement has been confirmed by an 8KOFDM hardware experiment.

articleTitle: Symbol-parallel Vlc Decoding Architecture For Hdtv Application
abstract: In this paper, a new VLC(Variab1e Length Code) decoding architecture is presented where multiple shorter codes are decoded in parallel while longer codes are processed in each cycle. This multiple-symbol decoding scheme enables us to design high throughput VLC decoder required for HDTV receiver with lower operating frequency and minimum hardware overhead.

articleTitle: Zero If Satellite Tuners For DBS
abstract: A 950-2150 MHz zero IF (direct conversion) tuner for worldwide application and a simplified 950- 1450 MHz version for the North American market are presented. Architecture, front end performance, AGC circuitry, and adjacent channel filtering are discussed.

articleTitle: Vlsi Architecture Of Cdma Rake Receiver With Low Hardware Complexity For Pcs
abstract: In this paper, we propose a VLSI architecture of CDMA rake receiver which consists of a searcher and three fingers having some shared hardware blocks to reduce the hardware complexity. The proposed rake receiver suitable for IS-95 based CDMA PCS system was designed using VHDL and it contains about 30K logic gates. We also implemented our system on FPGA chips and it was successfully tested.

articleTitle: A Conferencing System For Real-time, Multiparty, Multimedia Services.
abstract: In this paper we describe a conferencing system designed to provide real-time, multiparty, fully interactive multimedia services. Group manager and media manager are implemented to support an conference. Feasibility has been confirmed by laboratory trials.

articleTitle: Local Multipoint Communications Systems: Network System Architectures For Broadband Internet Access
abstract: LMCS (local multipoint communications systems) network architectures for Internet access are designed based on the Korean government frequency allocation notice[ 11. The parameters of frame structures, modulation demodulation methods, and MAC protocol are selected from DAVIC specification[2], and the protocol structures for Internet access are designed using internetworking protocols between IP and ATM.

articleTitle: Portable User Interfaces For Remote Access To Embedded Home Systems And Home Networks
abstract: The design and implementation of portable, lightweight user-interfaces to provide access to remote embedded home-systems and home-networks is described. This paper is focused on emerging standards in the consumer electronics field, including embedded-Java, the handheld device markup language (HDML) and remote frame buffer (RFB) technology as implemented in the public-domain virtual network computer (WC.) software.

articleTitle: Image Navigation Directory For Distributing High And Uniform Quality Images To Video Display Terminals
abstract: An image database management system has been constructed utilizing an image navigation directory. The image navigation directory (JND) has a new function of distributing uniformly high quality images to video display terminals (VDTs) which generally have different display characteristics. The new function of the IND is to convert stored images such as natural pictures and character images to the images of high quality and less fatigue respectively when they would be displayed on user's VDTs.

articleTitle: Realpush Network: A New Push-type Content Delivery System Using Reliable Multicast And Flexible Browser
abstract: We have developed U new push-system that simultaneously distributes Web-contents over the Internet to muss users. This paper discusses its flexible browser for end-users, broadcasting server for content distributors, and reliable multicast for efficient delivery.

articleTitle: Design And Implementation Of A Client-server Based Real-time Protocol On High Speed Ethernet Networks
abstract: A pure-software, token-based MAC protocol on high speed Ethernet networks is proposed and implemented on popular Windows NT to support realtime multimedia applications. The protocol includes the benefits of both time division multiplexing and token passing and avoids their drawbacks. The client-server model is more suitable in switched Ethernet LANs nowadays and it provides robust error handling mechanisms. A leaky-bucket concept is also implemented to increase the maximum number of nodes permitted in the LAN. Furthermore, a transport protocol is implemented to support call admission control and real-time data transmission.

articleTitle: Advanced Media Processor Chips
abstract: Media processors will provide an effective solution for consumer products, including digital televisions (DTV). These flexible processors enable platforms for customer-added product differentiation in the form of software rather than hardware. A single media processor can execute audio, video, 3D graphics and communications functions which have traditionally been performed by several individual hardwired chips. We include an overview of media processors, comparing them to previous fixed-function implementations.

articleTitle: An MPEG Decoder with Embedded Compression for Memory Reduction
abstract: We present an MPEG decoder with reduced system costs by employing embedded compression of the reference frames which are used for motion-compensated (MC) decoding. The compression features simple recovery of (MC) block data, while preventing visible artifacts. The compression was optimized for low costs, enabling real application in a commercial MPEG IC.

articleTitle: Digital Watermarking For Copyright Protection Of MPEG2 Compressed Video
abstract: Digital watermarking is the technique which embeds the invisible signal into multimedia data such as audio, video, images, for copyright protection, including owner identification and copy control information. This paper proposes a new watermarking technique which is appropriate for MPEG2 video coding system by extending the direct sequence spread spectrum. The proposed watermarking scheme in this paper minimizes the degradation of video quality caused by embedded watermark. And this technique can also directly extract embedded watermark information from watermarked MPEG2 compressed video stream without using original video sequences, which is robust for various attacks and appropriate for real time implementation.

articleTitle: High-quality Bit-rate Transformation For The Home Media Station
abstract: This paper discusses methods for bit-rate transformation of previously encoded compressed video bitstreams. The proposed high-quality, low-complexity bit-rate transformation algorithms are especially suitable for consumer devices such as the Home Media Station - a sophisticated multimedia receiver/decoder/recorder for consumer use.

articleTitle: Software Solution Of Gps Baseband Processing
abstract: Software for a GPS receiver using an embedded microprocessor achieves baseband processing; spectrum despreading, BPSK demodulation, satellite acquisition/tracking and data recovery. It enables signals from 8 satellites to be demodulated at approximate 40 MIPS.

articleTitle: Digital Still Camera System For Megapixel CCD
abstract: We have developed a digital still camera system to process images by hardware for monitoring, and by software for generating still images. The system is capable of processing from VGA (640 X 480) to SXGA (1280 X 960) size images by setting parameters.

articleTitle: Implementing Real-time Video Decoding On Multimedia Processors By Complexity Prediction Techniques
abstract: This paper presents a new technique capable of predicting the processing time of video decoding tasks. The proposed method provides a solution to the problem of guaranteeing, at the same time, real-time performance and an eficient use of the processing power. It gives the possibility of implementing optimal resource allocation strategies, and it is the key for providing a high quality of services when the required processing resources exceed the available ones. The technique is based on the collection and transmission in the compressed video bit-stream, of suitable statistics of the decoding process. The described technique, which is of general application on any processor platform, has been included in the new MPEG-4 IS0 standard.

articleTitle: A High Performance VLSI Architecture Design for 10/100Mbps Ethernet Switching Fabric
abstract: We present the design and implementation of an integrated 10Mbps and 100 Mbps Ethernet switching hub controller. The controller supports two 100Mbps and eight 10 Mbps Ethernet ports.

articleTitle: A Subband Based Spatio-temporal Noise Reduction Technique For Interlaced Video Signals
abstract: The reduction of gaussian noise is still an important task in video systems. The presented scheme consists mainly of a subband based recursive temporal filter adapted to special properties of the human visual system. This filter is supported by a spatial filter with low hardware expense, which consists of an image analysing highpass filter bank and an adaptive lowpass FIR-filter for noise reduction.

articleTitle: Digital Image Stabilizing Algorithms Based On Bit-plane Matching
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new DIS(Digita1 Image Stabilization) scheme based on the block matching technique using the bit-plane images. The proposed motion estimation process can be implemented using only binary Boolean functions which have significantly reduced computational complexity. We compared the proposed algorithm with existing algorithms using RMSE(Root Mean Square Error) on the basis of the full-search block matching method. Simulation results show that the proposed motion estimation algorithm outperforms conventional fast algorithms.

articleTitle: A New Timing Recovery Method For Dtv Receivers
abstract: We report a new unsynchronized timing recovery method designed for receiving digital TV signals modulated in 256QAM, QPSK and VSB format. The new method includes a simplified and efficient interpolator design, and a fast converging PLL. It can be used for fixed rate as well as variable rate applications. The algorithm was developed using SPW, and verified on an FPGA-based prototype board using real data[1].

articleTitle: An Integrated Dtv Receiver For Atsc Digital Television Standard
abstract: This paper describes a system structure of a DTV receiver capable of decoding a terrestrial broadcast signal which conforms to the ATSC digital television standard[1]. A newly developed chip set is used to realize a compact decoder unit.

articleTitle: Impacts Of I/q Imbalance On Qpsk-ofdm-qam Detection
abstract: The impacts of IIQ imbalances in the quadrature down-converter on the performance of an QPSK-OFDM-QAM system are studied. It is shown that both amplitude and phase imbalances cause inter-channel interference; they jointly cause IIQ cross-talk in each and every sub-carriers. The BER (Bit Error Ratio) performances of the QPSK sub-carriers are calculated to illustrate the impacts of I/Q imbalances.

articleTitle: Floating 3d Image Display Using Hoe Device And Holographic Screen
abstract: Holography has been recognized as a powerful medium of full 3D image display for a long time. However, its progress has been delayed by large amounts of calculations and a lack of a suitable display device. The authors are researching a floating 3D image display which consists of a holographic optical element(H0E) device and a holographic screen. The HOE device generates holographic 3D images at high speed, and the holographic screen enlarges the image. We demonstrate a floating 3D image which is part of 100 points. The image size is approximately 30 mm cube with 16 degrees viewing area.

articleTitle: Dynamic Scheduling Techniques For Interactive Hypermedia Servers
abstract: A dynamic approach to the retrieval of continuous media data (video in particular) in an interactive hypermedia server (IHMS) is developed to eliminate disruptions and delays in the concurrent delivery of data streams from storage devices.

articleTitle: Non-linear Digital Audio Processor For Dedicated Loudspeaker Systems
abstract: In this paper a non-linear loudspeaker model, which accurately reproduces the low frequency behavior, is presented. Moreover, a DSP is used to implement a multirate non-linear processor, which produces operates on the audio signal in order to achieve both compensation of non linear behavior and equalization of harmonic response. Results obtained measuring a commercial woofer are discussed.

articleTitle: Vsp: A Digital Watermark Method For Motion Picture Copyright Protection
abstract: This paper proposes a new digital watermark method for motion pictures. Three features of the method are (1) the embedded marks are imperceptible to human eyes in real-time, slow motion, and even stop-motion playback; (2) marks are never found in unmarked pictures; and (3) the marks can be detected in both pixel data and MPEG data. The effectiveness of the method has been demonstrated experimentally using various kinds of motion pictures.

articleTitle: An Analog To Digital Processor For Camcorders And Digital Still Camera
abstract: An analog to digital processor for imaging with CCD’s includes an input clamp, a correlated double sampler (CDS) and a logarithmic voltage controlled attenuator before final amplification. Autozero loops provide for a low offset independent of gain changes. A 10 bit 22MHz A/D provides a digital output. The entire chip has dimensions of 107 mils by 164 mils and dissipates 180 mw. The processor can operate at speeds up to 22 MHz and voltages down to 2.7 volts.

articleTitle: Economy Picture-in-picture Processor
abstract: A low cost, high performance multi-standard Picture-in-Picture processor IC1 featuring embedded memory is presented. The IC inserts live, reduced-screen-size video signals into a mainstream video signal, and can display split screens by compressing the mainstream video in the horizontal direction.

articleTitle: New Protocol Architecture Asel
abstract: ASEL (ATM over 1394 Serial bus Emulation Layer) is new protocol architecture which we have developed. As the result of implementation of ASEL entities on ATMA394 Bridge and 1394 Terminals, VCCs (Virtual Channel Connections) can be established over ATM and IEEE1394 network. Thus, the system achieves cost effectiveness by sharing expensive ATM port among the 1394 Terminals and guarantee of QoS (Quality of Service) for Multimedia data streams.

articleTitle: Unique Signal Identifier As An Md To Digital Tuning
abstract: A 16 bit station identifier code, sent in the VI31 allows DTV receivers to provide special tuning services.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Out-of-focus Blur Estimation And Restoration For A Digital Auto-focusing System
abstract: In order to increase accuracy in estimating the point spread function (PSF) of out-of-focus blur, we subdivided the input image and then averaged PSFs from each sub-image. The PSF of each subimage is estimated by differentiating step response along the appropriately estimated edge direction under assumption that an image usually has piece-wise linear boundary between an object and background. Once the averaged PSF is obtained we can use any kind of image restoration filter according to a specific application requirements, such as computational complexity or processing time.

articleTitle: Multiresolution Image Coding For Wireless Channel
abstract: In this paper, pyramid coding with AMBTC for the base band and geometric VQ for the high bands is proposed for the digital European cordless telecommunication (DECT) system. The impact of the channel fading on this technique is investigated at different BER. The received image is reconstructed with a high visual quality at rate of 0.3873 bpp and SNR of 36.73 dB

articleTitle: A Broadcast Quality Video Processor With Integrated Time Base Correction
abstract: A IO-bit broadcast quality composite video decoder is presented. This highly integrated solution includes time base correction (TBC), video enhancement functions and on-chip PLL and NCO loops which require a single reference clock for all processing. Comparisons are made to alternative schemes, which exhibit lower quantitative performance and subjective quality.

articleTitle: 3d Computer Graphics System For Dtv Applications
abstract: This paper describes a three dimensional computer graphics (3DCG) system for digital television (DTV) applications.

articleTitle: A Vlsi Implementation Of Dual Ac-3 And Mpeg-2 Audio Decoder
abstract: This paper presents a dual AC-3 and MPEG-2 audio decoder which can decode both bit-streams. MPEG-2 synthesis filtering process is modified by the 32-point FFT to establish the common data-path with AC-3’s. The designed decoder consists of a programmable DSP core and a hardwired common synthesis filter. The proposed system has been synthesized with 0.6 μ m technology and proven to be cost-effective

articleTitle: A Three-tier, Tcp/ip Gateway Architecture To Link Home Networks With The Internet.
abstract: A three-tier gateway architecture for internetworking between home automation networks and a TCP/IP based wide area network, such as the internet, is described. The architecture abstracts the functionality of any home network into a driver layer (tier one), and provides a common access layer (tier two) from any TCP/IP network application (tier three) to a local home automation network. Clients and application programs may transparently access services and resources on the home network and appliances connected to the home network may access resources and services on the TCP/IP network.

articleTitle: A General Architecture For Quadrature Constant Envelope Modulation Techniques
abstract: A simple baseband processor architecture to implement the Gaussian Minimum Shift Keying (GMSK) and a newly developed Feher’s Quadrature Phase Shifi Keying (FQPSK) using quadrature cross-correlated Feher patented [I] is presented for personal communication system (PCS). The newly developed FQPSK signals called filtered FQPSK, which lead to a great improvement of the spectral efficiency, are obtained by using additional post low-pass filters in the cross-correlated FQPSK structure. This architecture takes advantage of symmetry properties of the baseband signal Waveforms to lead to signif cant reduction in ROM memory requirements. The designs of GMSK and FQPSK for the “Global System for Mobile Communications” (GSM) with a bit rate of 270.833 kb/s and 16 samples per symbol were implemented in Xilinx FPGA chip.

articleTitle: The Design Of Nvod Server For Adsl-based Broadband Multimedia Network
abstract: This paper proposes a parallel processing architecture for a NVOD server. Combined with ADSL-based multimedia network, the proposed server can provide VOD service for most residential and business users without elaborating on the costly deployment of new subscriber loops.

articleTitle: Real Time Atm Implementation For Remote Access To Home- Automation And Entertainment Networks
abstract: Remote access to a home automation network from a computer with an Internet connection, using a Internet/Home Bus gateway is already possible [1,2]. However, an inherent limitation of the TCPAP protocol is its inability to provide an end-to-end delay guarantee in the case of applications which must provide real-time responses to events on the home network. [An example of such an application might be a ”network diagnosis service” [3] which would remotely analyze and test the behavior of your home network and the devices connected to it. Such a service will be needed by modern consumers as more and more domestic appliances become Home Bus enabled].

articleTitle: Gaphical User Interface For A Digital Media Computer
abstract: Unlike either the set-top box or the PC, both of which have some features in common with it, the Digital Media Computer (DMC) is a “hybrid” appliance whose exact nature is still unclear. It is a contention of this paper that a successful DMC Graphical User Interface (GUI must attempt to clarify this “hybrid” status. For purposes of illustration, one particular GUI solution is examined, with special emphasis given to look and feel issues, highlevel system navigation, and centralized device control.

articleTitle: Long Cable Phy For IEEE1394
abstract: This paper describes a new PHY of IEEE1394, that stretches cable length fkom 4.5m to 1OOm. The developed PHY can use UTP5 or POF, by changing a part of PHY of conventional IEEE 1394.

articleTitle: Scaling Up A IEEE 1394 Dv Network To An Enterprise Video Lan With Atm Technology
abstract: This paper presents a new video LAN architecture which enables a user friendly and scalable enterprise-wide network of consumer digital video equipment's by using a combination of EEE1394 and ATM technology.

articleTitle: A Low Cost, Low Power Video Processor For High Quality Motion Estimation In Mpeg-2 Encoding
abstract: A novel architecture dedicated to perform user-defined motion estimation algorithms on MPEG-2 CCIR 601 sequences is presented. The proposed MIMD processor exposes software programmability at different levels allowing the user to define his own searching strategy and combine multiple chips in Master/Salve configuration to meet the required processing power. Moreover post-processing of motion vectors, computation of dual prime vectors for low delay coding and selection of macroblock prediction mode can be programmed on this architecture.

articleTitle: A Universal Cable Channel Mapping Approach
abstract: The CEMA Engineering Subcommittee R-4.3 has created a system for Cable Channel Mapping, documented in the standard EIA- 745 and Recommended Practice document CEB2 This system allows a cable television receiving device, such as a cable-ready television receiver or cable set-top box, the capability to determine which cable channels are selectable, and when necessary, re-map these user selectable channels to their tunable channel number.

articleTitle: Vlsi Implementation Of Visual Block Pattern Truncation Coding
abstract: The paper proposes a pipelined architecture of visual block pattern truncation coding algorithm to minimize mean square error. Using this chip, the VBPTC based system can be applied to real-time encoding for the moving pictures.

articleTitle: The Av Controller On Pc Using Av Plug
abstract: By utilizing AV plug, we developed an AV switcher prototype that runs on PC. It has a graphical interface that simulates traditional AV control amplifier and monitor screen. In the next step we plan to extend it as AV control server in middle - large scale network.

articleTitle: A Miniature Optical Transceiver For High Speed Pof Optical Link System
abstract: Plastic optical fiber(P0F) has very large core of 1 mm diameter. It allows to increase mechanical tolerance for mating accuracy of connectors and enables adaptation of inexpensive plastic molded connectors. Moreover, the transmission bandwidth of graded index-POF(I1-POF) has been increased over 1 Gbps.[l, 2, 3,4]

articleTitle: Linking Television To The Internet: Eia-746 And Beyond
abstract: In 1997, the Television Data Systems Subcommittee (TDSS) within the Consumer Electronics Manufacturers Association (CEMA) approved EIA-746, a standard for transmitting Internet Uniform Resource Locators (URLs), and related information, within NTSC video signals. EIA-746 builds on EIA-608, the standard for encoding closed captioning information within television broadcasts. The first programs to use this standard were broadcast in the United States in November 1997, on a test basis, with national commercial broadcasts beginning in January 1998.

articleTitle: A Vlsi Implementation Of A Configurable Rational Filter
abstract: In this paper we propose a realization of a programmable filter for various processing applications. The algorithms are based on Rational Operators, whose robustness and structure allow us to design a fast and compact system.

articleTitle: A Dct-based Embedded Image Coder Using Wavelet Structure Of Dct For Very Low Bit Rate Video Codec
abstract: This paper presents an efficient DCT-based embedded image coder designed for I(Intra)-frame coding in very low bit rate video codec. Motivated by the recognition that a DCT on NxN blocks of an image can be viewed as a wavelet decomposition with a uniform NxN-subband decomposition, the proposed coder rearranges the DCT transformed image into 2-level wavelet pyramid structure and makes use of embedded zerotree coding. Simulation results show the better rate-distortion performance than conventional H.263 as well as EZW-style coders.

articleTitle: An Asic Implementation Of An Optimized Digital Video Encoder
abstract: This paper presents a design of an optimized video encoder by using a pipelined architecture of multiplierless structures. The proposed video encoder accepts conventional NTSUPAL video signals. It also processes the PAL-plus video signal, which is popular in Europe. The proposed encoder requires only 25k gates, which is a 40% reduction in hardware compared with conventional systolic pipelined architecture. The overall performance has been verified by using 0.65μ m CMOS process.

articleTitle: Software Control Of I/o Subsystem On Media Core Processor
abstract: To reduce cost of DVD player, we have integrated peripheral functions to audio and video decoder LSI. The peripheral functions are controlled by I/O processing tasks on single U0 control processor. I/O processing tasks are switched in constant cycle without overhead, to get real-time performance and flexibility of software control. In the case of video output handling, software can control each line parameter. Therefore, software with line level support of hardware can perform many functions; image resizing, copy guard and dynamic blending of image and graphics.

articleTitle: New Optical Atm Switching Networks Using Code-division Multiple Access For Broadband Communication Applications
abstract: New optical ATM networks are designed, using optical processing and code-division multiple access. Since their processing speed is high, this can support real-time broadband communication services with both variable and constant bit rates (e.g., HDTV and video conferencing with the MPEG-2 standard).

articleTitle: An Algorithm To Extract Camera-shaking Degree And Noise Variance In The Peak-trace Domain.
abstract: In this paper, an efficient algorithm based on the new working domain (the Peak-Trace Domain) is proposed to use the signal dominant region for the extraction of camera-shaking degree and noise variance. These parameters can be used to restore noisy motion-blurred image.

articleTitle: Nudan - A Multifunctional Home Automation Network
abstract: In this paper we present a summary of the operation of a new Home Automation Networking system. The system is designed to produce a highly functional, low cost network, which remains capable of evolving to encompass new ideas and technologies.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Disparity Estimation Using Spatial Correlation
abstract: In this paper, we propose a fast hierarchical algorithm for disparity estimation, which is based on the multiresolution block matching technique with prospective disparity vectors. Moreover, a smoothness criteria using the distance measures of the vector of the template block with its spatially adjacent predictors is adopted to modify the cost function so as to smooth the disparity vector field. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can reduce computation cost drastically while maintaining comparable PSNR quality.

articleTitle: Atsc Vsb If/demodulation Ic Development
abstract: The VSB IF demodulator IC was developed for the ATSC VSB Digital Receiver System. Major functions of this IC include IF signal amplification with automatic gain control, carrier recovery of the pilot frequency using an FPLL (Frequency Phase Locked Loop), and synchronous demodulation of the I and Q channels. These functions along with the performance results are documented in this paper.

articleTitle: A hybrid W-transform-based coding and its VLSI realization for image compression
abstract: We propose an image compression algorithm that combines the W-transform, normalized quantization, and entropy coding to enhance the compression ratio. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm achieves a higher compression rate compared to the JPEG and the other previously proposed W-transform based method. Since the W-transform plays an important role in multi-resolution image processing applications and is the core operation in our image compression system, we realize it on a VLSI chip in order to increase the system speed performance. The processor can compute the W-transform of any length (even or odd) in a very high throughput rate using only 8 arithmetic processing elements. The physical design of the processor based on 0.6 /spl mu/m cell library is also included.

articleTitle: Fully Digital Type Ntsc Decoder For Pc-base Video-phone System
abstract: We designed a fully cllgital type XTSUNational Television System Committee) decoder having no analog parts for PC-base video-phone systems. The Proposed digital type has the following benefits. It requires less silicon area than that of an analog type as the process technology improves. There are no circuit characteristic shifts due to temperature variations and aging. Design process is simple due to the digital circuit nature.

articleTitle: Mutual Interference Between Adjacent Analog Scwbled Signal And 64 Qam Signal In Caw System
abstract: On mutual interference between an analog sync. pulse compressed (scrambled) signal and an adjacent 64 QAM signal, experimental results, their cause, and guide of designing equipment6 was described.

articleTitle: Channel Allocation Problem In Vod System Using Both Batching And Adaptive Piggybacking
abstract: In a Video-on-Demand (VOD) system, it is important to minimize the resource requirements since resources such as network bandwidth and disk bandwidth are very expensive. Thus, it is highly desirable to let multiple streams share a single logical channel. It allows more subscribers to enjoy VOD services than available channels can support. We propose a novel method that can minimize the number of logical channels. Its optimality and effectiveness is demonstrated.

articleTitle: 3d Digital Broadcasting System And Ird Using Progressive Scanned Digital Broadcasting
abstract: This paper describes the new& developed 30 digital broadcasting system and the IRD (Integrated Receiver and Decoder) enabling the broadcast of 30 images using high-definition progressive scanned digital broadcasting with additional simple functions.

articleTitle: Improvement Of Sound Image Localization F'or Headphone Listening By Wavelet Analysys
abstract: Wavelet analysis of a sound image localization transfer function for headphone listening reveals two important features for headphone listening reveals two important features for spatial hearing. By introducing these features into a localization equalizing filter, the sound image localization is improved.

articleTitle: Combining Multiple-candidate Search With One-bit Transform For Motion Estimation
abstract: In this paper, we improve the performance using the results of one-bit transform as the initial estimate of the motion vector, and use re-examination strategies to find the final motion vector. Experiment results show thut the proposed method improves the performance of the one-bit transform by up to 0.9 dB and outperforms many other motion estimation algorithms such as the Three-Step Search (3SS), New Three-Step Seurch (N3SS) and the Four-Step Search (4SS).

articleTitle: A New Pll Frequency Synthesizer Using Multi-programmable
abstract: Higher speed lock-up time than conventional can be achieved by introducing a multi-programmable divider into PLL frequency synthesizer. Unlike the fractional method ,this has been done without the increase of the reference frequency.

articleTitle: Design Of A Scan Converter Using The Bisigmoidal Interpolation
abstract: This paper describes a system that converts a wide range of personal computer video formats to a target format. The conversion is performed based on the bisigmoidal interpolation, and look-up tables are used for efficient hardware implementation of that interpolation.

articleTitle: A Multimedia Conferencing System With Synchronized 3d Graphics For Distance Learning
abstract: This paper presents a multimedia distance education system, called GVA (Global Virtual Academy). The GVA system is unique in that its synchronized 3D graphics greatly enhances the learning mechanism together with other advanced multimedia distance learning features, such as real-time full duplex voice talking, text chatting, and a shared white board on top of a web browser.

articleTitle: Overview Of Digital Video In Broadband Networks
abstract: This paper summarizes the approaches that have been taken by the ATM Forum, the ITU-T, the IETF and the DAVIC standard bodies to integrate broadcast and fully interactive digital video in broadband networks.

articleTitle: Harmonic Vector Excitation Coding Of Speech At 2.0-4.0 Kbps
abstract: A low rate speech coding algorithm, Harmonic Vector Excitation Coding (HVXC) [ 13 is proposed for MPEG-4 standardization, in which combination of weighted vector quantization of harmonic spectral envelope of LPC residual signal for voiced segments [2] and vector excitation coding (VXC) for unvoiced segments are employed for 2.0 and 4.0 kbps coding. New features of the proposed coder includes a quantizer scheme capable of generating 2.0 and 4.0kbps scalable bit-streams, where 2.0 kbps decoding is possible using a subset of 4.0kbps bit-stream.

articleTitle: A Compact and Anti-Environmental-Noise Microphone/Receiver Unit for Portable Terminals
abstract: A compact and anti-environmental noise microphone/receiver unit for portable terminals has been developed. The transmitted voice signal is made up of air-and bone-conductive voice signals. The mixing ratio of air-conductive voice signals and bone-conductive voice signals is controlled according to noise.

articleTitle: Adaptive adjustment of the search window for block-matching algorithm with variable block size
abstract: An adaptive adjustment of the search window for block-matching algorithm(BMA) with variable size of the block is presented to reduce the computational complexity of full search BMA(FSBhL4). The size of the search window is adjusted by using the block similarity and the displaced block difference(DBD). Experiments with test video sequences show that the presented scheme has good MSE performance and less complexity compared with FSBMA and other previous works.

articleTitle: ATSC VSB Re-Modulator System
abstract: This paper shows an inexpensive VSB modulator implementation to interconnect between various digital entertainment products and digital VSB TV receiver. This approach is the digital equivalent to the current analog re-modulators found in VCRs and video games.

articleTitle: A Distributed And Collaborative Graphics Rendering System
abstract: In this paper, we describe a distributed and collaborative graphics rendering system. This graphics rendering system integrates many hot techniques such as Java/Web, VRML/graphics and distributed/parallel processing. Using this system, multi-users on the Internet can edit their 3D scenes in a collaborative manner. A distributed photo-realistic render is then used to generate the final image sequence.

articleTitle: Local Multipoint Communication Systems (lmcs) In Canada
abstract: Canada recently licensed three organizations to implement Local Multipoint Communication System (LMCS) in different markets. This new 28 GHz wireless network will offer broadband services such as digital video or Internet access. Some tests have been completed to evaluate the performance of a modulation technique, Coded Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (COFDM), for LMCS systems.

articleTitle: Code Phase Synchronization Technique In Ds/ss Packet Radio Communications Under A Rayleigh Fading Channel
abstract: In this paper we present a code phase synchronization scheme which employs differential detection structure with a novel verification method incorporated for the coincidence detection. To cope with the unknown, fluctuating SNRs of incoming packets, a detection window technique[2] is used. This novel verification method effectively eliminates the beforehand computation[3][4] which is needed to find the optimum threshold level. We applied this synchronization scheme to the mobile satellite environment and found that the differential detection structure could subdue error-incurring sidelobes quite effectively, and that significant improvement in terms of packet loss probability also be achieved.

articleTitle: Design And Implementation Of An Mpeg-2 Transport Stream Multiplexer For Hdtv Satellite Broadcasting
abstract: This paper describes design and implementation of an HDTV program multiplexer which is based on MPEG2 transport streams for satellite broadcasting. We have developed an MPEG-2 TS compliant multiplexer with special considerations for timing and synchronization. In particular, we introduce a scheduling algorithm, which use the monitoring information of the buffers of T-STD as one of scheduling factors. We have also implemented a software simulator and used it for efficient verification of MPEG-2 compliance from early design stage.

articleTitle: A Single-chip Front End For Dvb-t Receivers
abstract: A low-cost single-chip front end for terrestrial digital television receivers is presented that is compliant to the European DVB-T Standard. The front end chip contains a digital demodulator for 2K carrier OFDM modulation and a channel decoder for forward error correction codes specified by DVB.

articleTitle: Set Top Performance Benchmarking As A System Design Tool
abstract: A benchmark is a tool to evaluate system performance before and after a product has been designed. This paper will address a series of theoretical benchmarks for the design of digital set top box architectures.

articleTitle: Practical Design Of Receiver For Satellite Digital Broadcasting
abstract: A digital broadcasting via satellite using 12GHz band is planned from 2000 year in Japan. This paper describes a structure of the receiver set, the key technology to receive new services and the performance of prototype receiver.

articleTitle: A Dual Mode Digital Camera For Digital Still Imaging And Video Conferencing
abstract: The novel camera architecture was created to meet the demands of the emerging market of PC Imaging. The emphasis is on the creation, manipulation, and sharing of images in the PC and the use of images on networks. The primary display medium for sharing images is intended to be the CRT. Additionally, the device is designed to support both portable still and tethered video image capture.

articleTitle: Implementation, Integration And Testing Of A T.120-series Protocols For Multimedia Conferencing
abstract: T. 120-Series protocols collectively propose a multipoint data communication service for use in multimedia conferencing environments. In this paper, we describe systematic methods for the implementation of T. 120-Series protocols. Integration of T. 120-Series protocols is also addressed. Moreover, we implemented a T.120 Protocol Analyzer which is a very useful tool to do the interoperability test with other T. 120 systems. The features of our T.120 Analyzer are software-based, real-time and lose-less packet grabbing, and no interference to network operations.

articleTitle: Qop/qos Control For Multiresolution Video Applications Over Atm Networks
abstract: We present a mechanism of QoP/QoS control in multiresolution MPEG scalable coding structure. The video quality of presentation (QoP) can simply be mapped to the network requirements and the end-to-end quality of service (QoS) is achieved.

articleTitle: Audio Transfer System On Phs Using Error-protected Stereo Twinvq
abstract: This paper proposes an efficient stereo coding scheme with error protection based on transformed vector quantization. It also reports a handy terminal with a single-DSP decoder, which enables an audio transmission service over mobile channels.

articleTitle: An Fpga Receiver For Wireless Lans Employing Cpsk Spread Spectrum Signaling
abstract: This paper presents the design of an M-ary direct sequence spread spectrum (DS/SS) receiver for wireless LANs employing a novel Code-Phase-shift Keying (CPSK) signaling scheme. Receiver implementation using an FPGA for baseband detection is described, and performance measurements are given.

articleTitle: Advanced Pre/post-processing For Dct Coded Images
abstract: This paper presents the result of non-linear adaptive filters applied as pre and post-processing of DCT coded images. The pre-processing is applied to enhance the coding efficiency removing noise information. The main goal of the post-processing phase is to reduce the blocking and ringing both due to the quantisation of the DCT coefficients.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Encryption Method Suitable For Copyright Protection
abstract: We propose a new lightweight encryption algorithm, so called M6. This algorithm has high performance and sufficient robustness, so that M6 is suitable for copyright protection system for both CE and IT devices.

articleTitle: Dynamic Characteristics Of Disk Vibration And Rotaing Airflow In Magneto Optical Drive
abstract: A study on dynamic characteristics of rotating disks in magneto optical disk drives is presented. Natural frequencies of rotating disks are investigated experimentally and numerically. The frequency response and critical speeds of the disk are discussed. The characteristics of airjlow around the disk and their eflects on disk vibrations are also investigated.

articleTitle: The Block-based Preprocessing System For The Coding Performance Improvement
abstract: In this paper, a new preprocessing algorithm is proposed to improve coding performance, both reducing noise and maintaining the clearness of an original image. Experimental results show the significant improvement in coding performance as compared with no preprocessing.

articleTitle: Conditional Access System Interoperability Through Software Downloading
abstract: Software downloading of interoperable program code like Java opens up new opportunities for interoperability between conditional access (CA) systems and Set-Top Boxes. This paper describes how software downloading can be used in addition to (and instead of) current solutions for CA-system STB interoperability.

articleTitle: Closed-captioning For Pip
abstract: The usefulness of PIP is often impaired by its lack of audio. Using closed-captioning data provides an ideal solution to this problem. PIP captions are displayed in a window directly beneath the PIP and are reformatted to maximize readability and intelligibility.

articleTitle: 1998 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics [Front Matter and Table of Contents]
abstract: Presents the front matter and table of contents from the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Author index
abstract: The author index contains an entry for each author and coauthor included in the proceedings record.

articleTitle: A Robust Channel Equalizer For Ofdm Tv Receivers
abstract: In this paper we present and analyze a nonparametric channel equalizer based on the moving average estimator. Since the OFDM system can be considered as a set of parallel gaussian channels with different frequency gain for each subcarrier, we apply the theory of sample mean to each subcarrier by averaging the consecutive data symbols. Assuming the channel attenuations and the transmitted data symbols are constant while taking averages, this effectively removes noise and we can obtain the data symbols distorted only by the multipath channel. The proposed method does not require any a priori knowledge about the channel statistics. Furthermore, it has the performance improvement over conventional schemes even for slowly time-varying channels. We evaluate the equalizer through simulation using a 16 QAM OFDM system.

articleTitle: Design And Implementation Of Hdtv Broadcasting System Via Satellite
abstract: In this paper, we introduce main service characteristics and overall architecture of Korean HDTV broadcasting system being developed in order to provide high quality TV program and data services to large numbers of people via Koreasat. Then, it is described major functions of HDTV broadcast chain and presented design specifications and implementation of the system.

articleTitle: Vlsi Architecture Of Signal Processing Chip Set For 42-inch Dc Pdp Hdtv Receiver
abstract: A signal processing chip set for 42-inch DC PDP HDTV receivers has been developed. Four kinds of signal processing LSIs are fabricated with a semi-custom LSI design and 0.35 ,μ m triple-metal CMOS technology. This paper describes the architecture of the LSI chip set and new circuit configurations to improve the picture quality. The chip set has enabled a practical PDP HDTV receiver to be fabricated.

articleTitle: Perfect Flat Crt Discussed From A Standpoin Of "viewing Performance "
abstract: This paper reviews why perfect flat CRT l)screen gives viewers natural impression in viewing pictures displayed on CRT screen through the analysis of relationship among CRT's screen surface radius, viewer's eye point and picture distortion. To achieve perfect flat screen in large-sized CRT, several new technologies are required . The new tempered glass technology adopted in CRT for the first time. With this technology, perfect flat CRT was realized in almost similar weight to that of conventional CRT tube.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Design For Low Power Communication Systems
abstract: This paper describes a low power design methodology and compares synchronous and asynchronous system design techniques for low power implementations. It is shown that due to the inherent wastefulness of the clocking mechanism within synchronous systems, better power performance-cost ratios can be obtained by utilizing asynchronous techniques. Furthermore, by using asynchronous design techniques, we can minimize the noise associated with the clocking mechanism, and produce superior communication components. We illustrate our findings with a case study of a high-level design DSP chipset.

articleTitle: Low Phase Noise And Low Intermodulation Analog Front-end For An Ofdm System
abstract: We have newly developed an analog front-end with low phase noise, low intermodulation and high linearity characteristics which can be applicable to an OFDM system. The double conversion architecture using the GaAs mixer ICs, a low phase noise local oscillator construction and a delayed gain control system are discussed.

articleTitle: Development Of Dv 1394 Digital Interface Software
abstract: Convergence of PCs and consumer electronic equipment has been frequently mentioned in the last few years. The emergence of 1394 provides the ability to connect digital AN equipment to the PC for applications such as image capturing and video editing. One of the first A/V devices to support 1394 is the DV camcorder. In this paper, the software that was developed to support a 1394 interface for capturing and transmission of DV on the PC will be described, as well as the development issues and solutions discovered in the process.

articleTitle: A Highly Optimized Processor For Compressed Audio Application
abstract: An optimized audio processor for compressed audio application has been developed. The processor employs a dual-processor architecture. One of the two processors is a 26-bit fixed-point signal processor for high quality audio signal processing. The other is a 16-bit data processor optimized for compressed bit stream. In compressed audio applications, not only signal processing such as FFT, but also data comparison and bit manipulation is necessary.

articleTitle: A High Performance Low Cost Fm Demodulator Lsi For Satellite Receivers
abstract: A high performance and low cost FM demodulator LSI for satellite receivers has been developed. Three new technologies have been adopted in this LSI;. integrated variable reactance, a full digital AFT, and a wide dynamic range transconductance amplifier are described.

articleTitle: A New Joint Algolithm Of Symbol Timing And Sampling Clock Adjustment For Ofdm Systems
abstract: This paper introduces a new time synchronization algorithm for OFDM which consists of symbol timing recovery and sampling clock adjustment using the pilot carriers. The performance of the algorithm is carried out under AWGN and multipath fading channel.

articleTitle: A Speech Input Interface For Web Page Query Based On A Dynamic Language Model Architecture
abstract: Speech query is more natural and convenient than text in the Web page information retrieval. The severe problem for speech query is that there exist out-of-vocabulary words or unknown words in most of the Web pages and this induces the difficulty to recognize the speech from syllable lattice into the correct text. In this paper, we propose a dynamic language model architecture that is a Web page based language model to correctly convert speech into text.

articleTitle: Highly Integrated Single-chip Baseband Processor For Gsm Handsets
abstract: A highly-integrated single-chip baseband processor for next-generation GSM personal communications handsets was designed and implemented. The chip's architecture is suited for new and emerging GSM standards for enhanced full-rate speech, high-rate multi-slot, and packet-radio service. The chip's architecture and key system design and implementation issues are described.

articleTitle: Design Of The Coupling Schemes For The Dolby Ac-3 Coder In Stereo Coding
abstract: When applying the Dolby AC-3 coder the for stereo music compression, the coupling scheme is the key technology for the Dolby AC-3 to achieve a bit rate lower than 96x2 kbit per second while preserving high stereo audio quality. This paper proposes four coupling schemes for the AC-3 encoder. These four methods vary with the complexity and the performance. These four methods are compared through both subjective and objective tests.

articleTitle: A Design And Implementation Of Rtu And Rsu Transceiver For Wll System
abstract: The implementation of radio transceiver unit(RTU) and radio subscriber unit(RSU) transceiver for Korean wireless local loop(WLL) system based on WCDMA is presented in this paper. RTU transceiver consists of three boards; receiver, transmitter and RF controller. RSU transceiver is divided into three parts; receiver, transmitter and IF board. At the RTU receiver, the experimental measurement showed 2.86dB of NF. At the RTU transmitter, the -49.34dBc of adjacent channel power rejection(ACPR) is attained when the output power of the transmitter is 34.3dBm. At the RSU receiver, the experimental measurement shows 5.65dB of NF. The measured ACPR of the RSU transmitter is -49.33dBc when the RSU transmitter operates in normal state. These results are good enough to meet required performance specifications.

articleTitle: Dab-micro-transmitter For Insertion Of Local Windows
abstract: By incorporating micro-transmitters into a given DAB-SFN (Digital Audio Broadcasting - Single Frequency Network), service providers are able to replace the information content of a specified single channel inside the predefined ensemble so that it is of local interest. There must be no interference with neighboring channels, which must still be receivable within the small radiation field (e.g. 300m3 of the micro-transmitter without loss of information content. The consequent technical problems are analyzed and discussed and measurements are reported which were derived from an experiment set up to demonstrate the operating principle. Conclusions and outlook are given.

articleTitle: Intelligent Call Manager Based On The Integration Of Computer Telephony, Internet And Speech Processing
abstract: The Intelligent Call Manager, a unified call management system, integrates computer telephony, Internet and speech processing. This system can answer an incoming call, transfer the call to an extension, send a voice mail and call the pager. Using natural speech interface, the intelligent call manager servers callers efficiently and courteously.

articleTitle: A Generic System For Wireless Access Using Dect Air Interface
abstract: The extraordinary commercial success of cellular phones and laptop personal computers, during the last decade, demonstrate the enormous interest of users for mobile and wireless communications.

articleTitle: A Study Of Tape Drive Using Ultrasonic Vibration Drum
abstract: In order to improve the tracking accuracy of the VCR, we have developed an USV(ultra-sonic vibration) drum that can drive tape directly on its surface. The settling time of the transient response was about 30 percent shorter than that of the conventional capstan.

articleTitle: A Development Ofanewvideo Signilkl Processing System And Its Lsi Based On The 8mm Video Format
abstract: We have developed a new video signal processing system and its LSI based on the 8mm video format. Their contribution causes drastic reduction in power consumption compared with our previous systems as well as realization of producing camcorders in much smaller size.

articleTitle: The Development Of A Dsp For Speech Signal Processing And Applications
abstract: This paper describes a newly developed digital signal processor (DSP) suitable for speech processing. The DSP has specialized functions for normalization to adjust dynamic range of speech signal in a cycle, and for table look-up fast codebook search.

articleTitle: The Mpeg Audio Real-time Coding System
abstract: Recently, MPEG technology is becoming popular in multimedia world because of its encoding/decoding efficiency. In such demand, we developed a compact MPEG camera(1)(2) for consumer users to handle MPEG video and audio as easy as camcorder. The MPEG camera encodes/decodes image with using a newly developed MPEG-I CODEC LSI(2), and audio with software.

articleTitle: User-identification On Windows Environment By Using The Speech
abstract: The personal confirmation in the multimedia environment such as WINDOWS 95 is a basic function so that the password is usually used. The password can be plagiary because the existing method uses the password through the keypad so that the reliable personal confirmation method is necessary. As the method to cope with this defects, if the speech of users to confirm the users is used, it can offer the convenience to users and prevent the plagiary of password from the others. As such a method, the ability to reject a impostor is important. So the training method for reference patterns is raised for critical problem. Therefore, in this paper, the method related to the training method that improves the ability of rejecting a impostor is proposed.

articleTitle: An Mpeg-2 Encoder/authoring System For DVD Title Production
abstract: A high performance MPEG-2 Video Encoder and DVD Authoring System are described. The MPEG-2 Encoder has a capability of variable bit rate (VBR) coding and bistream editing for high quality picture compression, and special coding functions for DVD, such as bit rate control for seamless play back and variable length GOP control. Multiple elementary streams decoder and video stream log information files which are integrated in a large scale decentralized DVD Authoring System realize an excellent productivity of DVD title.

articleTitle: New Method Of Internet Access Within A Dbs Environment
abstract: DBS(Digita1 Broadcasting System) using MPEG-2 TS has been developed and is beginning on the services. To offer a internet service, we evolve the DBS system efficiently and adopt a terrestrial network. In this paper, we describe the configuration and the communication control mechanism for interne? service on the DBS Environment.

articleTitle: Dynamic Rate Scaling Of Coded Digital Video For Ivod Applications
abstract: The compressed bitstream scaler which scales an precoded bitstream down to an arbitrary lower bit rate is a key mechanism to construct an open IVOD (Interactive Video On Demand) system, since the ultimate transmission bandwidth is seldom known when the video program is compressed and installed on video server. In this paper, we consider the content creation encoding and bitstream scaling jointly to improve the performance of bitstream scaler in VOD system environment and an effective rate control algorithm is proposed. Simulation results show that proposed scheme performs better than direct coding with the TM5 rate control at the same bit rate.

articleTitle: Newly Developed Ird Built-in D-vhs Vcr System For Dvb Broadcasts
abstract: Newly developed IRD built-in D-VHS VCR system allows digital bit stream recording of DISH Network’s MPEG2DVB signal with original broadcasting picture quality maintained. This paper describes the concept, applied technologies and the system original features.

articleTitle: Recording Teletext On Vhs Tape
abstract: Normal VHS video recorders cannot record teletext data. A new system is proposed to add this function to a VCR economically, using the standard VHS mechanism, tapes and circuitry. This would allow home recording of teletext and subtitles, as well as other applications 1.

articleTitle: Hdtv Digital Format Translator
abstract: In this paper a HDTV Digital Format Translator system is introduced. The system block diagram is provided, the signal processing algorithms are described, and the system performance is discussed.

articleTitle: An Authentication Protocol For Intelligent Home Automation Systems
abstract: This paper presents an authentication protocol based on the SPEW strong password method to address current information-security deficiencies in most intelligent Home Automation systems. The protocol was developed specifically around constraints and limitations imposed by practical low-cost ' micro-controller implementations of consumer electronic equipment and appliances.

articleTitle: Dvd/cd/cd-r Compatible Pick-up With Two-wavelength Two-beam Laser
abstract: Demands have been strong for a compatible play function allowing CD-ROMs and CD-Rs to be played in DVD-ROM drive equipment. To meet these demands, we have developed a pick-up that adopts a two-wavelength two-beam laser and a holographic element for wavelength selection, making it possible for a single pick-up to play DVDs, CDs, and CD-Rs.

articleTitle: A Java Based Multi-tier Architecture For Enterprise Computing: A Case Study From An University Academic Information System
abstract: We present in this paper a Java based multi-tier architecture for enterprise computing. The architecture has been used successfully in developing the academic information system of the National ChiNan University. The system shows that the functionality, performance, and total cost of the proposed architecture are all quite well for enterprise application development. For performance of the system, its response time is 4 times faster than the IDC version, and 6 times faster than the CGI version using Visual Basic.

articleTitle: An Mpeg2-to-atm Converter To Optimize Performance Of Vbr Video Broadcast Over Atm Networks
abstract: We propose an MPEG2-to-ATM converter for VBR video broadcast over ATM networks. It partitions video data into high priority ATM cells which always conform to the service contract, and minimizes the impact of loss of low priority cells on the received video quality.

articleTitle: A New High Performance Wireless Indoor Lan Modem For The Multimedia Communication
abstract: We present an implementation of FPGA chipset for a new wireless LAN modem that combines 64 GAM modulation with OFDM to improve data transmission rate from 2Mbps to 6Mbps.

articleTitle: Regularized Interative Image Interpolation and its application to Spatially Scalable Coding
abstract: This paper presents a regularized iterative image interpolation algorithm, which can restore high frequency details in the original high resolution image. In order to apply the regularization approach to the interpolation procedure, we Arst present a two-dimensional separable image degradation model for a low resolution imaging system. According to the model, we propose a regularization based spatial image sequence interpolation algorithm and apply the proposed algorithm to a spatially scalable coding.

articleTitle: An Implementation Of Digital Dbs Encoder With Dvb Scrambler
abstract: This paper shows how the video/audio encoder should work with other subsystem such as RSMS and MUX(Multiplexer). Also, we introduce how to implement the video/audio encoder with DVB scrambler which is to scramble video/audio programs. In addition, it describes how we control program for subscription and pay-per-view channels.

articleTitle: A Novel Gui For Car Navigation System Based On Vrml
abstract: A novel graphic user interface concept for car navigation is presented. Main concepts include the map orientation according to the direction of driving, and level of details to prune off useless information from the map. Virtual reality modeling language supports the implementation of these features.

articleTitle: Development of the PC Card Receiver for FM Subcarrier Data Broadcasting
abstract: The PC card receiver for the FM subcarrier data broadcasting called DARC (Data Radio Channel) and the method of scanning some FM stations with a single tuner and presentation their programs simultaneously are discussed.

articleTitle: A Multi-services Communications Architecture For In-home USB and IEEE-1394 Based Devices
abstract: This paper discusses a flexible in-home communications architecture interfacing external networks to Universal Serial Bus (USB) and LEEE-1394 High Performance Serial Bus based end-terminal devices. A smart network interface unit 0, or residential gateway, functions as the bridge between outside networks, namely telephony and coaxial cable plants, and existing in-home wiring formed by telephone lines, coax cable, and power lines. The USB and IEEE- 13 94 based end-terminal devices connect to the in-home wiring through wiring termination nodes (WTN) or cable termination nodes (CTN). The WTN and CTN communicate with the NIU and are basically hubs with a modified upstream port.

articleTitle: An New Adaptive Quantization To Reduce Blocking Effect
abstract: n this paper, we present a method to reduce the blocking effects in block based coding schemes. Based on our observation, the blocking effect appears mainly in the region with fast or complex motion which is not well compensated. But this region tends to be coarsely quantized in the traditional method using only the spatial activity measure.

articleTitle: Adaptive Traffic Management Model For Internet/electronic Commerce
abstract: The success of E-commerce critically depends on the reliability of the Internet, and the speed with which real-time data and multimedia applications may be allowed to transmit over it. This would require an effective strategy for Internet Traffic Management. The paper suggests the Resource Reservation Protocol (RSVP), a standard developed by the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF), as a suitable solution for handling time-critical traffic.

articleTitle: A New Postprocessing Method For The Block-based DCT Coding Based On The Convex-projection Theory
abstract: The block-based DCT coding has been adopted in image compression standards such as JPEG and MPEGs. This scheme causes some noticeable artifacts. The most obvious artifact at low bit rate coding has been referred to as the blocking effect. This paper presents a postprocessing method to reduce the blocking effect while prevents the processed image from being blurred. The method has been checked to be better than the existing methods through the subjective and the objective measures.

articleTitle: Fast Fractal Image Encoding Via One-bit Transforms
abstract: In this paper we present an algorithm for faster Fractal Image coding than traditional algorithms. The algorithm involves a method of transforming the image from a multibit to an one-bit/pixel representation, applying MPEG like, full search block based estimation on the new image and then refining the result with the use of statistical normalization and fast block-based motion estimation techniques for MPEG encoding. Simulation results suggest that the algorithm can significantly reduce the computation compared to traditional methods and also reduce both arithmetic and hardware complexity.

articleTitle: Ccd Noise Filtering Based On 3-d Pde
abstract: In this paper a three dimensional anisotropic diffusion equation is proposed to remove noise in video sequences. The three dimensional anisotropic diffusion equation utilizes the fact that consecutive frames of high correlation can be obtained in video sequences. It will be shown that the three dimensional diffusion equation gives better results than the two dimensional diffusion equation which only deals with still images and slowly smooths the boundaries.

articleTitle: A New Vlsi Architecture For Interleaved Filtering Of Sampled Signals
abstract: A VLSI architecture is presented for the filtering and decimation of the WV video signals where the color difference signals U and V are sampled at the half of the sampling rate of the luminance signal Y. In this architecture we interleave the three signals Y, U and V with different sampling rates in such a way that the decimation filters only have to be implemented once to produce all three decimated Y, U and V signals at the output. The technique has been applied to the high-speed CMOS implementation of an analog-to-digital-conversion circuit for high-quality video applications.

articleTitle: Distributed Consumer Network Architecture
abstract: This paper describes an architecture to realize cooperative applications using distributed consumer appliances.

articleTitle: A Transceiver Using Simplex Plastic Optical Fiber For IEEE 1394
abstract: Currently, stepped Index Plastic Optical Fiber (SIPOF) is able to transmit 100 Mbps data stream over loom cable length using a Laser Diode (LD) at optical wavelength of 650 nm (Table 1). Meanwhile, solution for connectivity of 5Om to loom necessary in using IEEE1394 as home network is awaited for a long time.

articleTitle: A Singple-Chip MPEG2 MP@ML Video Encoder LSI Including Wide Search Range Motion Estimation (H+/-288, V+/-96) and Many Functions for Consumer Use
abstract: A MPEG2 MP@ML Video Encoder LSI has been developed integrating a motion estimator (with maximum search area of the +/-288 horizontal and +/-% vertical pixels) and many functions for consumer application use. The two algorithms are used for motion estimation and low power consumption is achieved by using special design methodology.[l] In This paper, the LSI architecture is described.

articleTitle: The Effect Of 3rd Order Intermodulation Distortion On Qam Digital Set-top-box In Cable Tv Systems
abstract: Composite-triple-beat (CTB) distortion in cable TV systems, which degrades the BER performance of digital modulation signal, is discussed. The amplitude probability distribution and its effect on the QAM signal are evaluated through computer simulation.

articleTitle: Card-size Digital Still Camera Utdizing A Novel Cmos Image Sensor
abstract: A new compact and low power consuming digital still camera featuring a 330K pixel CMOS image sensor, power saving function, and high speed data transfer, was developed especially for mobile application.

articleTitle: Optical Fiber Transmission Of Packet Data Multiplexed With Digital Audio And Video Signals
abstract: This paper describes a compact system for transmitting digital NTSC TV signals using plastic optical fibers. In the system, up to 18 channels are used for packet data at a maximum speed of 1.764 Mbps and digital audio signals are inserted into the horizontal sync. The insertion of the digital audio signal and packet data into the horizontal sync of the digital NTSC TV signal keeps the transmission rate unchanged at 50 Mbps.

articleTitle: Vlsi Implementation Of The Motion Estimator With Two-dimensional Data-reuse
abstract: This paper describes the VLSI implementation with two-dimensional (2-D) data-reuse for full-search block-matching algorithm. Based on a one-dimensional processing element (PE) array and two data-interlacing shift-register arrays, the same chips can be cascaded for different block sizes, search ranges, and pixel rates.

articleTitle: Transport Content Advisory Information (v-chip) In The Vbi
abstract: The U.S. Government’s activity to enable blocking of certain program-provider rated television by parents is traced. The industry standard for transmitting program ratings is explained as is the required timetable for receiver implementation.

articleTitle: A Modulation Technique For Integrating Digital Subchannels Within A Pal/palplus Signal
abstract: A methodology for modulating digital signals within the active video portion of a conventional PAL / PALplus signal is presented. The resulting crosstalk distortions are examined and a model postulated that enables optimization of parameters by balancing subjective quality with data-rate.

articleTitle: A Middle Frequency Compensation Scheme For Wavelet Transform Coding
abstract: To overcome the degradation problem existed in conventional wavelet transform coding, this paper presents a new approach for still image compression. The approach is based on the concept of middle frequency compensation scheme [l] and combines the zerotree coding and the Vector Quantization (VQ) technique for middle frequency compression. The proposed approach can improve the JPEG method over 2.8dB for 0.25bpp. Also, the result is substantially better than the embedded zerotreeof wavelet (EZW) coding [2] which can achieved a compression ratio of 33.17dB for 0.25 bpp in which the adaptive arithmetic coding is included.

articleTitle: A Digital High-performance Multi-standard Video Data Slicer
abstract: This paper describes the implementation of a multi-standard video data slicer. It was designed to process data of a variety of services like Teletext, Closed-Caption etc. in multiple video norms like PAL and NTSC. For achieving high performance, the concept is completely digital and contains a self-adjusting equalizer.

articleTitle: A Flexible Heterogeneous Video Processor System For Television Applications.
abstract: A new video processing architecture for TV applications is presented, featuring a flexible heterogeneous multi-processor architecture executing video tasks in parallel and independently. The signal flow graph and the processors are programmable, enabling an optimal picture quality for different TV display modes. The concept is verified by an experimental chip design.

articleTitle: Erroneous Mpeg Packet Synchronization In Fec Decoder Of The Mcns/scte/ltu-t J.83 Annex B Standard
