abstract: This paper presents a phenomenon with repeating data packets sent according to the MCNS (Multimedia Cable Network System) DOCSIS (Data Over Cable Service Interface Specification)/SCTE (Society of Cable Television Engineers)/ITU-T 5.83 Annex B standard. When repeating packets are received by a receiver, the receiver may erroneously lock onto the bit stream and produces incorrect MPEG packets. Repeating packets are usually not generated in practical systems.

articleTitle: Development Of A Very Low Power Consumption Lsi For Transmission Of Video And Audio Signals Using Ir
abstract: We have developed a one-chip IR transmission signal management LSI. As a result of this development, drastic reduction both in power consumption as well as in numbers of associated discrete components is achieved. This LSI facilitates wireless connection between a camcorder and a television receiver set.

articleTitle: Speech Synthesis Software For A 32-bit Microprocessor
abstract: Speech synthesis software for an embedded 32-bit microprocessor has been developed. It has achieved a processing power of 1.5 MIPS with the small memory size of 500 Kbytes for a code and voice database.

articleTitle: A Digital Vestigial-sideband Decoder Ic For Digita
abstract: This paper describes an integrated 8-VSB demodulator-decoder IC which can receive Digital TV (DTV) signals that are formatted according to the ATSC standard.

articleTitle: A 3d Graphics Library For Embedded Systems
abstract: A 3D graphics library for a 32-bit embedded microprocessor has been implemented without FPU and graphic accelerators. By adopting sophisticated techniques related to multiplication and division, the library achieves 10,000 polygons/sec using only software.

articleTitle: Formal Modeling And Design Of Multimedia Synchronization For Interactive Multimedia Presentations In Distributed Environments*
abstract: To provide flexible multimedia presentations, user interactive service becomes an essential requirement in a lot of multimedia applications, e.g., news on demand. Since media bases are located remotely in distributed environments, more considerations must be involved to deal with the synchronization issue. In this paper, we propose an Interactive Extended Finite State Machine (IEFSM) specification model to formally model and design synchronous multimedia presentations with user interactions in distributed environments.

articleTitle: Dab In Catv Networks
abstract: It is not absolutely necessary for DAB (Digital Audio Broadcasting) signals to be inserted into CATV (Cable Television) networks within the CATV frequency range. Because the signals are robust they can also be transmitted beyond the usual boundaries of the usual frequency range. This paper has a discussion of experimental results and a design for a DAB converter.

articleTitle: Development Of The Virtual Sound Algorithm
abstract: Our virtual sound algorithm can create a virtual sound field using conventional 2 channel stereo speakers of no more than 3 MIPS in processor porformance. In addition, it can reproduce more natural and more comfortable sound than before.

articleTitle: Front-end Of A Digital Atv Receiver
abstract: This paper describes the front-end of a digital ATV receiver. The prototype of the board, which contains a tuner, a Surface Acoustic Wave (SAW) filter, a downconverter, a Vestigal Sideband (VSB) demodulator, an Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC), and an on-board microprocessor was developed, built and troubleshot. The design is highly integrated and manufactured on a single printed circuit board.

articleTitle: Internet-aware Appliances For Digitally Encoded Music
abstract: We describe requirements and system architectures for a new generation of Internet appliances that are designed to allow consumers to locate, purchase, play, and share live and recorded music distributed over the Internet. These new portable devices can be used both on-line and off-line. We describe the advantages associated with this new technology for consumers, producers, and distributors, as well as features that encourage producers and distributors to make music available in new ways.

articleTitle: Www-efxer: A Java-based Video Editing System
abstract: To allow video authoring using low-end platforms, we have designed a Java-based video editing system using a client-server framework. In the system, the process of video editing is split into a low-resolution authoring stage and a high-resolution production stage which are carried out in the client site and the server site respectively.

articleTitle: An Area Efficient Architecture For 3d Graphics Shading *
abstract: A 3D graphics shading module is presented to provide flat shading, Gouraud shading and Phong Shading in this paper. A fast Phong shading algorithm, H-test, is applied to this design. The features of this design is to realize the lighting model and interpolation by logarithm space divider, and logarithm space exponent. The post layout simulation results show that the system can operate up to clock rate of 68.9MHz. This implies that pixel rate up to 34.5M pixels per second and 222K 10 x 10, Gouraud shaded polygon rate per second and 172K Phong shaded polygon can be achieved.

articleTitle: High End Implementation Of Dvb-t Ofdm Demodulator Using General Purpose Dsps.
abstract: This work deals with the implementation of OFDM demodulation, channel estimation and equalization functional blocks, using 200 MHz, 1600 MIPS, fixed point DSPs in a dual processor configuration, for DVB-T receivers in the 8k mode. The adoption of general purpose DSPs provides a great flexibility in the development of different configurations of the receiver (for example the 2k mode) and enables the feasibility of adaptive equalization schemes in which the quality of the channel estimation is varied according to both channel characteristics and speed of the channel variations.

articleTitle: Compliance Bitstreams For Testing Atsc Decoders
abstract: Several complementary sets of bitstreams have been created to provide more complete testing of ATSC Digital Television decoders. These bitstreams test MPEG-2 video syntax, ATSC formats, audio-video synchronization, and error concealment, by observing only the decoded video and audio.

articleTitle: An Area-efficient Survivor Path Architecture For Viterbi Decoders
abstract: A new survivor path architecture is proposed. The required memory depth is reduced to two times of the truncation length. The usage of single-port memory and four-phase trace-back scheme raise the design density that suits the commercial applications.

articleTitle: The Set-top Box As ,,multi-media Terminal"
abstract: The current platform for Digital Television Services in Germany, the ,,d-box", based on the DVBMPEG-2 standards provides the technical basis for the handling of ,,Multi-Media" Services. With the integrated Modem, SCART, and SCSI-2 interfaces, the d-box offers two Service Classes: Video/Audio Services, and Data Services. This paper discusses important technical consumer and commercial aspects of providing Multi-Media Services over satellite and cable involving both a TV and a PC connected to a Multi-Media Terminal (d-box).

articleTitle: Transmission System For Multimedia Services In Satellite Broadcasting Channels
abstract: The configuration, and characteristics of a, transmission system for satellite digital broadcasting in Japan are described. This system become a technical standard for such broadcasting on the Broadcasting Satellite Service (BSS) band of Japan in 1998. The satellite broadcasting is scheduled to be launched in the year 2000. The system secures a transmission capacity for two digital HDTV programs on one satellite channel. It can also transmit a variety of multimedia service, including HDTV, SDTV, sound, and data.

articleTitle: Improving The Spectral Efficiency For The Ofdm System Using The Time And Frequency Domain Equalization
abstract: In this article, we propose the dual equalization in both time and frequency domain. Thus it is possible to shorten the guard interval while maintaining the bit error rate performance or improve the bit error rate performance while maintaining the guard interval DFE (Decision Feedback Equalization) is introduced for time-domain equalization while conventional I-tap linear equalizers are used for frequency-domain equalization. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm on the multipath channel specified in ETSI Draft prETS 300 744.

articleTitle: What's Behind The Panel?
abstract: The arrival of multi-format DTV and advances in display technology suggesting that these multiple formats may be commonly viewed on pixelated displays have brought to the fore questions that tended to be hidden in an arcane province of the display system engineer. This paper provides a brief overview of the challenges in maintaining high image quality while affordably executing real-time temporal and spatial scaling, color space conversion, pixel resampling, waveform generation for both pulse width and amplitude modulation for a range of display technologies including flat panels whose display characteristics and addressing modes continue to evolve.

articleTitle: A Video Backend For Multimedia Tv-sets
abstract: Advanced multimedia TV-sets can handle double scan TV sources (100Hz, progressive scan, VGA, SVGA) with resolutions up to 800 x 600 at 60 Hz. In addition wide screens (1 6:9 aspect ratio) are attractive for displaying video and PC graphics side by side. This could become a key feature for WWW-ready TV-sets.

articleTitle: Overview Of Test And Measurement Devices For Digital Television Bitstreams
abstract: An overview of real-time and off-line analysis of digital television bitstreams is presented. Important compliance considerations and available test equipment for product manufacturers and service providers are discussed. Real-time MPEG transport analyzer implementations are presented as examples.

articleTitle: Performance Of The Viterbi Decoder For Dvb-t In Rayleigh Fading Channels
abstract: In this paper, we present the performance of the Viterbi decoder using the soft decision method for the European DVB-T specification in Rayleigh fading channels. We investigate the bit error rate (BER) performance of the Viterbi decoder for hard and soft decisions in terms of the decoding depth and the number of bits for the soft decision. We also consider the decoder performance in a Doppler shift. The simulation results show that the Viterbi decoder with 5-bit decision and the decoding depth of 55 is the sub-optimum decoder.

articleTitle: Dvb Integrated Satellite Receiver Decoder Pc Card
abstract: This paper deals with an extension card which upgrades a personal computer (PC) for the reception and processing of DVB (Digital Video Broadcasting)- compliant satellite signals. It includes the MPEG-2 decoding and the video representation in a window of the graphical user interface by means of a high quality video overlay technique. A variety of hardware and software interfaces allows the adaptation to a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: A New Fast Symbol Timing Recovery Algorithm For Ofdm Systems
abstract: In this paper, we propose an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) synchronization algorithm to achieve a fast start-up and to synchronize the symbol timing phase using the scattered pilots under the frequency offset, the common phase error, and severe noise. With the proposed algorithm, we can detect up to k35sample offsets and can recover the sampling timing phase even in the carrir frequency offset of up to k0.35 OFDM sub-carrier space. So, we can much reduce the start-up time by simultaneously operating both the carrier and symbol timing recovery loops.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Web Browser For Internet/electronic Commerce
abstract: During the emergence of Intemet technology in recent years, it is obvious that Electronic Commerce has rapidly become one of the most prominent applications in this field. As the first generation Intemet technology mainly focused on the content providing, e.g., news, art, et. al. The browser and search engine provides a readily available tool for users to surf the Web and to locate their subject of interest according to their individual needs and requirement. The Electronic Commerce however introduces significantly different and more stringent functional requirements for the Internet technology such as real time transaction processing, and traffic management, encryption secured data transmission, et. al.

articleTitle: Optimized Electronic Addressing For A Reflective Microelectromechanical Spatial Light Modulator
abstract: In this paper we trace the evolution of the Digital Micromirror Device (DMDTM), emphasizing electromechanical performance and reliability. We explore the relationships between DMD reliability, device electronic architecture, and pixel dynamics. Development of high-reliability waveforms for the DMD has resulted in significant performance increases; we describe their impact on sequential color display systems. We also discuss several stochastic variables that affect display uniformity.

articleTitle: Display Processor Ic For Tv And Svga Signals
abstract: A new display processor for high end TV receivers has been developed 1). The IC generates all signals needed to drive both the deflection and the guns of a picture tube. It can be used for single and double scan TV signals, as well as for SVGA signals with line frequencies up to 50 kHz.

articleTitle: Advanced Receiver Chip For Terrestrial DVB: Archietecture And Performance
abstract: A DVB-T compliant single-chip CMOS device for COFDM terrestrial digital TV reception has been developed recently. This paper presents the chip architecture and details on the performance under various channel conditions.

articleTitle: Video Search Technology For The Pc/tv Domain
abstract: The converging PC/TV market is providing consumer access to an enormous amount of high quality video material. The technologies used to usefully describe video content include video segmentation and abstraction as precursors to the creation of an easily accessible video index. This approach can be used in a variety of consumer applications, including a home video library which cuts out the commercials from TV broadcasts.

articleTitle: A New Oqpsk Carrier Phase Recovery Algorithm In Satellite Channel
abstract: This paper proposes a new extended decision-directed decision-estimated phase recovery algorithm based on maximum likelihood parameter estimation for OQPSK.

articleTitle: A Demapping Method Using The Pilots In Cofdm System
abstract: This paper is concerning about the demapping method using the pilots inserted in transmitter in COFDM(Coded Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) system which is the standard transmission system of terrestrial digital TV in Europe[1]. We have tested the demapping method of this paper under the standard Rayleigh and Ricean fading channel and obtained better performance than conventional soft decision demapper.

articleTitle: Surfing The Chinese Web Pages By Unconstrained Mandarin Speech
abstract: This paper presents a prototype Mandarin speech interface for using unconstrained Mandarin speech to control the WWW browser for conveniently browsing the Chinese pages. The interface currently provides speakable commands, bookmarks, and links.

articleTitle: A 1.8 Ghz Cmos Frequency Synthesizer With High-speed Vco For Pcs Receivers
abstract: This paper presents a 1.8 GHz CMOS frequency synthesizer with high-speed on-chip VCO for PCS (Personal Communication System) receiver.

articleTitle: A Self-timing Audio D/a Converter Supporting Burst Inputs Suitable For High-end Usb Applications
abstract: This paper describes the structure of an asynchronous Digital to Analog Converter specifically designed to convert audio samples transmitted over multimedia buses characterized by burst streams. A specific application for Universal Serial Bus has been studied and designed.

articleTitle: Development Of An Automatic Reverse System For Vcrs
abstract: A VCR capable of automatic reverse recording has been developed by arranging the forward and return tracks in a mutually interleaved form. The system can be utilized for consumer and digital VCRs.

articleTitle: Real-time Implementation Of Mpeg-2 Audio Codec On A Dsp
abstract: This paper describes the implementation of MPEG-2 audio coding and decoding in real-time using a fired-point DSP. Improved coding algorithms and advantages of DSP in audio processing are also discussed.

articleTitle: Bit Allocation Method For Dolby Ac-3 Encoder
abstract: The complexity of the audio encoders is always higher than that of the decoders. A main process leading to the higher complexity is the bit allocation. Especially, AC-3 has adopted a hybrid coding strategy [4] which leads to higher allocation difficulty. This paper proposes an efficient method for the bit allocation process.

articleTitle: A Prototype Of Mandarin Voice Memo System
abstract: In this paper, a prototype of Mandarin voice memo system which provides functions of automatic notification and voice retrieval is implemented on a PC. The techniques include both general content-based and special date-time expression based voice retrieval approaches.

articleTitle: Implementation Of An Admission Controller For High-speed Multimedia Networks
abstract: In the paper, we use a fuzzy development toolkit to implement a neural fuzzy connection admission (NFCAC) scheme proposed in [2]. The setting of the fuzzy rule bases and their related parameters can be easily done via the aid of the graphic user interface.

articleTitle: A Consumer Digital Vcr For Digital Broadcasting
abstract: IRD built-in VCR for recording the digital broadcasting has been developed. This VCR is based on the D-VHS standard and records digital bit-stream data of the digital broadcasting. For this VCR, we have developed one-chip digital signal processing MI, interface LSI and digital recording heads. The newly developed heads are also used for recording Hi-Fi audio signal.

articleTitle: Switched Capacitor Bandpass Filter For Use In Home Audio Parametric Equalizer
abstract: In trying to reduce costs of stereo system, manufacturers are eliminating potentiometers and going to digital controls.

articleTitle: Development Of Memory Label System For Consumer Vcr
abstract: Developed a Memory Label System for the Consumer VCR application. Memory label is attached on a video cassette, and it carries index as well as other information related to the contents of programs recorded to the video cassette.

articleTitle: 1.2kbps Fblpc Vocoder With Applications In Phone-to-phone Over Internet
abstract: Since the Mixed-Excitation Linear Predictive (MELP) Vocoder was selected as the new 2.4Kbps Federal Standard speech coder in 1996[1], the very low bit rate speech coding method has become new tendency for research. This paper presents a new LPC vocoder model(FBLPC) based on forward-backward waveform prediction[2] for very low bit rate speech coding. Besides, we use the technology to accomplish the application system named phone-to-phone over internet.

articleTitle: A Portable Java Api Interface For User Access To Digital Still Cameras
abstract: The digital camera is one of the main successes of recent years in consumer electronics. However a typical digital camera remains tied to proprietary software on a personal computer. In this paper we describe the design and implementation of a portable Java API to simplify end user access to digital cameras and to provide lnterc0nnectivit.y with a new generation of intelligent home applicances.
